Air Support Charges.text: The blueprint for 10 Air Support Charges is automatically available in the Foundry after installing a Landing Craft Foundry Segment. Each batch costs 4,000 Credits, 1,200 Ferrite, 2,000 Salvage, 1 Morphics, and 700 Plastids, and takes 1 minute to build.

Aerospri Dex Pixia Skin.text: The Aerospri Dex Pixia Skin is only available in the Market as part of the Titania Donann Skin for  165 or Titania Donann Collection for  195.

Atomicycle Summon.text: Atomicycle Summon is automatically acquired upon completion of The Hex quest.

Brickie Muon Battery.text: Muon Batteries are acquired by dismantling Brickies caught through Fishing. Go to The Business in Fortuna, select the desired amount of Brickies available, and select the "Dismantle" option to extract the components.

Dendrite Blastoma.text: Dendrite Blastoma can be obtained by filleting  Barbisteo and  Vitreospina (both from the Cambion Drift) at Daughter in the Necralisk.

Dual Swords Stavika Skin.text: This skin can be obtained by reaching Rank 18 in Nightwave: Nora's Mix Volume 1, available from March 16th, 2022. It can also be purchased from Ticker during the Star Days seasonal event for debt-bonds.

Embracer Ephemera.text: Obtained from defeating a Technocyte Coda, provided the Coda has the Ephemera themselves, regardless if they are Vanquished or Converted. Codas have a ~57% chance to appear with an Ephemera, otherwise they will spawn with an Emote or Captura Scene.

Eukar Claw Skin.text: This skin can be obtained by reaching Rank 13 in Nightwave Nora's Mix Volume 4, Available from May 24th, 2023.

Fish Meat.text: Fish Meat can be acquired by taking fish to Fisher Hai-Luk to have them filleted. The number of meat increases with the size of the fish captured, independently of weight.

Gammacor Day of the Dead Skin.text: This skin is available during Nights of Naberus as part of Naberus Treats from Daughter for x90  Mother Token each.

Gigelor Prime Syandana.text: Acquired by purchasing the Titania Prime Access, or from Prime Resurgence for 2  Regal Aya when it is in rotation.

Glaxion Polar Skin.text: The Glaxion Polar Skin was obtained by scoring 3000 points in a single Excavation mission in Operation Cryotic Front.

Grendel Prime Theme.text: The Somachord version of the theme can be bought from Varzia for 5  Aya

Kriller Thermal Laser.text: Thermal Lasers are acquired by dismantling Krillers caught through Fishing. Go to The Business in Fortuna, select the desired amount of Krillers available, and select the "Dismantle" option to extract the components.

Liftbalon Ephemera.text: Can be purchased during Operation: Atramentum from Aspirant Zorba in any Relays for 65  Nightmare Tatters once Community Progress has reached 90%.

Lovestruck Ephemera.text: Obtained from defeating a Technocyte Coda, provided the Coda has the Ephemera themselves, regardless if they are Vanquished or Converted. Codas have a ~57% chance to appear with an Ephemera, otherwise they will spawn with an Emote or Captura Scene.

Mirewinder Parallel Biode.text: Parallel Biodes are acquired by dismantling Mirewinders caught through Fishing. Go to The Business in Fortuna, select the desired amount of Mirewinders available, and select the "Dismantle" option to extract the components.

Multron.text: The Multron is automatically acquired upon obtaining  Oxylus. Note that this weapon also takes up one Companion inventory slot.

Nekros Prime Theme.text: The Somachord version of the theme can be bought from Varzia for 5  Aya.

Nukor Daybreak Skin.text: This skin could be obtained by reaching Rank 19 in Nightwave: Nora's Mix Volume 6, available from May 15th, 2024 and to September 3rd, 2024.

Oberon Obsidian Skin.text: The Oberon Obsidian Skin was available through the PlayStation store via the Renown Pack XV.

Okuri Tails Prime Ephemera.text: Obtained via Voruna Prime Access Accessories Pack, available from April 8, 2026.

Orion's Swaddle Syandana.text: Awarded to player via mailbox after completing the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest.

Pharaoh Predasite.text: Predasites are acquired through Revivification with Son in the Necralisk, Deimos. The player must capture a Weakened Pharaoh Predasite via Conservation after it has been attacked by Infested, as well as obtain a Mutagen and Antigen bought from Son with  Entrati Standing, and  5,000 to initiate the Revivification process.

Primatura Ephemera.text: Can be purchased during Operation: Atramentum from Aspirant Zorba in any Relays for 65  Nightmare Tatters once Community Progress has reached 30%.

Pustulent Cognitive Nodule.text: Pustulent Cognitive Nodules can be obtained by filleting Cryptosuctus and Aquapulmo (both from the Cambion Drift) through Daughter in the Necralisk

Revenant Mephisto Syandana.text: Purchase Revenant Mephisto Skin from the Market for  150.

Samia Towsun Syandana.text: Purchase from Nakak, Cetus for 350  Nakak Pearl during Dog Days.

Scrap.text: Scrap can be acquired by dismantling Servofish at The Business in Fortuna. The yield is increased by how intricate the caught fish is.

Sweeper.text: This Sentinel weapon is automatically acquired upon obtaining   Carrier. Note that this weapon also takes up one Companion inventory slot.

Temporal Dust.text: Temporal Dust can be acquired from Isleweaver as a possible end mission reward in quantities of 20 (25 in The Steel Path) or as an uncommon drop from  The Murmur enemies and Entrati storage containers.

TennoCon Riftguard Syandana (Void-swept).text: Originally obtained by purchasing the TennoCon 2025 Digital Pack. Now no longer available.

Tethra Data Fragments.text: Upon completing the Tethra's Doom Interception mission on Earth, players will be awarded two fragments regardless of how long they play per session.

Two-Handed Nikana Maligna Skin.text: This skin can be obtained by reaching Rank 22 in Nightwave: Series 2 — The Emissary, available from July 6th, 2019. It can also be obtained by reaching Rank 18 in Nightwave/Nora's Choice, available from August 4th, 2021.

Vasto Tekelu Skin.text: Automatically added to the player's inventory after acquiring Vasto Tekelu Skin, which is permanently available for purchase from in-game market separately for  20 or as part of The Tekelu Collection III bundle  80.

Volt Amethyst Skin.text: The Volt Amethyst Skin was available through the Discord store via the Reverence Pack, along with Excalibur Amethyst Skin & Mag Amethyst Skin.

Wirematrix Ephemera.text: Awarded from reaching certain ranks in Nightwave.

Zarina Ephemera.text: Obtained from defeating a  Heat Sister of Parvos, provided she has the Ephemera herself, regardless if she is Vanquished or Converted. Sisters have a 20% chance to appear with an Ephemera depending on the Warframe who created her.
